text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, Universe-san! To think you'd 
give me the entire starry sky as a 
birthday present!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"DIY" planetarium... Did it make Sounds of 
Earth "happy"?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
SÃ¬! Especially the sparkle of the stars; 
that fantastical twinkling is marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! To me, the starry sky resonated like a 
mystical canzone...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"MuTev"...! Sounds of Earth's "SNST," both 
the "analysis" and "composition" are 
"GRSS."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to "share"— Sounds of Earth's 
"window," HWTE's "Musica."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Um... in other words, did you try to 
understand it? My musica, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sfera... does that mean "love"? Because 
right now, my heart is completely full of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... "Amore" is also a form of sfera, 
isn't it?
